worked_solution:
The denominators are $5$ and $10.$ We can make a common denominator of $10$ by splitting the shape on the left into $2$ parts vertically:  

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14153326/assets/3d4839662bcac31bc197436b533da61e07ecf1ca301b3fa7613d433833e14028.png)

 

So, our division problem now is

$$
\dfrac{\color{red}6}{10} \div \dfrac{\color{blue}7}{10}.
$$

Since the denominators are equal, this is equivalent to

$$
{\color{red}6} \div {\color{blue}7} = \dfrac{6}{7}.
$$

Therefore, we conclude that

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14153326/assets/583d7875ca78bb24742c402e222b4ba221388163d17f2056372e204d27373043.svg)

Hence, the missing number is $6.$
